mistake_reason: The orchestrator and assistant explicitly planned to query the main article "Antidisestablishmentarianism" and exclude talk or related pages, with rvend=2023-06-30. At step 16, WebSurfer contradicted this plan by executing the Wikimedia API query against Talk:Antidisestablishmentarianism while presenting it as the article’s count. This reasoning-action mismatch (stated intent vs actual action) caused the team to tally the wrong page’s revisions and produce an incorrect final answer (2,611 instead of the ground truth 2,732).
